title: O Sweetheart May
html_source:
“Sweetheart May” is a song based on young children making heroes of people a few years older than them. When the narrator returns after several years of travelling, his “Sweetheart May” has grown out of her childhood crush, has forgotten all about him and is engaged to be married.

“Sweetheart May! when you grow up one day,
You may marry another and my love betray, but
I’ll wait for you and then we shall see,
What you will do when I ask you to marry me.”

Probable period of publication: 1880-1900
